mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite continuous upward trend in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 3.1% triggers a negative S&P 500 return over 20 days as higher rates signal tightening policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 rising and UNRATE falling.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% signals easing policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses below 2.5% in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses below 2.5% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly supply (INDPRO) indicates stronger production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite continuous upward trend in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) crossing above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as high unemployment signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 3.0% signals accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses below 3.0% in post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses below 3.0% in post-shock recovery.
